title: EcomWriteBench: A Real-World Benchmark for E-commerce Writing Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.27349v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used throughout e-commerce workflows to generate content that informs purchasing decisions and supports customer interactions. Evaluating these systems requires accounting for user needs, product evidence, structural constraints, and business requirements that are not fully captured by general-purpose writing benchmarks. We introduce EcomWriteBench, a real-world benchmark containing 3,861 queries from 69 e-commerce writing tasks across 13 categories and five languages. Through task-level extraction, cross-task consolidation, and refinement guided by human feedback, EcomWriteBench constructs a shared pool of 37 abilities and identifies the subset applicable to each task. Ability-wise scoring enables us to compare state-of-the-art LLMs on EcomWriteBench and characterize their relative strengths and weaknesses across fine-grained e-commerce writing abilities. translated_title: EcomWriteBench：面向电商写作任务的真实世界基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地被应用于电商工作流程中，用于生成影响购买决策和支持客户互动的内容。评估这些系统需要考虑用户需求、产品证据、结构约束和业务要求，而这些因素无法被通用写作基准完全涵盖。我们提出了 EcomWriteBench，这是一个真实世界基准，包含来自 13 个类别、五种语言的 69 个电商写作任务的 3,861 个查询。通过任务级提取、跨任务整合以及人工反馈指导的细化，EcomWriteBench 构建了一个包含 37 项能力的共享能力池，并识别出适用于每个任务的能力子集。基于能力的评分方式使我们能够在 EcomWriteBench 上比较最先进的大语言模型，并刻画它们在细粒度电商写作能力上的相对优势与劣势。我们进一步提出了一种偏好校准评估方法（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了 EcomWriteBench——一个涵盖 13 个类别、五种语言、69 个电商写作任务、共 3,861 个查询的真实世界基准，通过构建 37 项共享能力池并进行能力级评分，实现对大语言模型在细粒度电商写作能力上优劣势的系统评估。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces EcomWriteBench, a real-world benchmark comprising 3,861 queries across 69 e-commerce writing tasks in 13 categories and five languages, which constructs a shared pool of 37 abilities and enables fine-grained ability-wise evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs' strengths and weaknesses in e-commerce writing.
